title: The Analects
author: Confucius
text:
BOOK I

The Master said, Is it not pleasant to learn?

The Master said, Fine words seldom are associated with virtue.

title: Tao Te Ching
author: Laozi
text:
The Tao that can be trodden is not the enduring Tao.

All in the world know the beauty of the beautiful.

title: Zhuangzi: The Essential Writings
author: Zhuangzi
text: In the Northern Oblivion there is a fish.

title: The Great Learning
author: Attributed to Zengzi
text:
The point where to rest being known, the object of pursuit is then determined.

What the Great Learning teaches, is to illustrate illustrious virtue.
